description:
Top-level `OctoPi.AI.stream(model, context, options) :: Enumerable.t()`.

Internals:
- Spawn an unnamed GenServer per call.
- GenServer opens the provider's HTTP stream.
- Decodes SSE → maps to canonical events → forwards events as messages to the caller.
- Caller side: `Stream.resource/3` yielding the events.
- Cancellation: shutting down the Stream kills the GenServer; GenServer closes the HTTP request.

Validates the producer/consumer shape for the whole provider layer.
title: OctoPi.AI.stream/3 public entry (process-based producer)
